name: GhostChat
author: jorbach

sections.description:
GhostChat is the official WordPress plugin for The Chat Widget — a privacy-first, ultra-lightweight live chat. Perfect for businesses that care about page speed, visitor privacy, and GDPR compliance.

Note: This WordPress plugin is open source (GPL licensed). The Chat Widget service and platform are proprietary.

Why The Chat Widget?
* 3KB widget – 20-40x smaller than Intercom, Zendesk, Drift, Crisp
* Zero tracking, zero cookies – No cookie banners needed
* 10-30ms latency – Edge-powered global delivery
* Anonymous visitor sessions – Privacy by default
* Real-time messaging – Instant customer replies
* Mobile PWA dashboard – Reply from your phone like WhatsApp
* GDPR compliant – Built for privacy regulations

How it works:
1. Get started free at The Chat Widget
2. Create a site and get your Site ID
3. Enter your Site ID in the plugin settings
4. The chat widget appears on your site automatically

Pricing:
* Free: 1 site, 14-day message history, basic analytics, includes “Powered by” branding
* Pro ($5/mo): Up to 3 sites, 1-year message history, business hours automation, contact export (CSV), basic analytics, remove branding
* Business ($29/mo): Up to 10 sites, unlimited message history, business hours automation, contact export (CSV), advanced analytics, remove branding, priority support

Compare that to competitors charging $39-99/month!
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugin directory, or upload to /wp-content/plugins/the-chat-widget
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > GhostChat
  4. Enter your Site ID from your dashboard at app.thechatwidget.com
  5. Save changes – the widget appears instantly on your site!
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes, get started free at thechatwidget.com/get-started to create your account and get a Site ID.

Is it really free?

Yes! The Free plan includes 1 site and 14-day message history forever. Upgrade for more sites and features.

Does it slow down my site?

No! At 3KB, GhostChat is 20-40x smaller than competitors like Intercom (120KB+), Zendesk (150KB+), or Drift (200KB+). It has zero impact on page speed or Lighthouse scores.

Does it track visitors?

No. GhostChat uses zero tracking and zero cookies. Visitor sessions are anonymous. No cookie banners needed.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. GhostChat doesn’t track or store personal data without consent. Perfect for EU businesses.

Can I customize the widget?

Yes! Customize colors, position, and welcome messages in your dashboard.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes! The dashboard is a mobile-first PWA. Install it on your phone and reply to customers like WhatsApp.
